name: Armaments of the Legion raises Hateforged Barrier's absorb once, through aura 317 (#1351)
contract: Armaments of the Legion (rank 1, 706266) states one 10% bonus to Hateforged Barrier's (705129) absorption. The DBC gives it twice: Effect[1] aura 317 (SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_ABSORB_AMOUNT_PCT, scales the completed absorb) and Effect[2] a SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 (op3) 10% percent SpellMod on the family20 classMask bit26 flag, which read 1.21x. Owner ruling O-27 keeps one bonus; the Felsworn contract turns Effect[2] into a dummy (Felsworn ADR 0025), so rank 1 adds no op3 SpellMod and the 10% comes from aura 317 alone (the absorbed amount itself is judged by the conformance entry 706266 barrier_absorb).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Base Hateforged Barrier effect value is unaffected
Rank 1 adds no SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 modifier to Hateforged Barrier (owner ruling O-27: the 10% is aura 317 alone)
